name: identifier
remove: Every name the speaker says as separate words that the context writes as one token is written the context's way, including a name introduced by "the" and including one that keeps its capitals.

name: conventional-spelling
remove: Spell a well-known path, flag, or command the conventional way rather than as a homophone of it.

name: attachment
remove: A converted symbol joins the word beside it with no space between them.

name: layout
remove: "New line" is a single line break; "new paragraph" is a blank line between paragraphs.

name: spell-out
remove: When the speaker spells a word aloud — naming a letter it contains, or reciting it letter by letter — the letters say how to write the word and are not themselves content: write the word the spelled way and drop the spelling aside.
